rights_basis: Sefaria records this English version's licence as CC0, a public-domain dedication. The underlying Mishnah is ancient.
text: One would stand before the entrance to the courthouse, his scarf in his hand; and another would ride on a horse before them at a distance, in order to see him. [If] one says, I have an argument for acquittal, then he waves the scarf, and the horse runs to stop him.
